input: gonnna have more rogue agents contributing how do I harden settings and setup? / okay work on all of that.
task: Harden the repo against misbehaving agents: CODEOWNERS for the control plane, ruleset, control-plane guard, Environments for publishing secrets

doc_friction.issue: Only two workflows (conflict-markers, agent-cross-review) run on every PR, so a new required check needs its own unfiltered workflow; the ruleset JSON in the repo is not live until an admin applies it.

deviations.why: Moving the Cloudflare token into an environment would make portfolio-pages.yml's PR-time gate see no token and quietly fall back from the Cloudflare deploy
deviations.did: left Cloudflare, reviewer-key and Vercel secrets as repository secrets and documented why
deviations.result: 14 jobs in 3 environments; the catalogue deploy path untouched

goal: One misbehaving agent cannot rewrite the rules, hooks or merge gate for every other agent, or read publishing secrets from a branch
notes: Local checks: test_control_plane_guard 14 OK; control_plane_guard --check-coverage OK; agent-permission-harness check_results_current exit 0 on branch and on main, its 93 tests OK; check_md_links, check_code_refs, check_conflict_markers, promptctl validate clean. validate_workflows.py reports one pre-existing problem in distribution-versions-ci.yml (untouched). --pr and --audit-commit not run against the live API locally (no token). GitHub settings (agent identities, applying the ruleset, Actions settings, moving secrets, push protection) are owner steps listed in docs/security/agent-hardening.md.
